_note: F2：外企前端英文技术与STAR行为素材。lang=en隔离旧中文岗位线。问答全英文，复盘解析中文。

node.text: Please introduce one frontend project and your own contribution.

options.text: I'd start with one decision and the evidence behind it.
options.line: Okay, and how was that decided?

followup.text: Your team chose the overall design. How would you describe your role?

options.text: I'd separate the team's design choices from the part I built.
options.line: Good, that makes sense.

options.text: I'd describe the team result first, then my role if asked.
options.line: Okay, but what's your role in it?

options.text: Since I shipped the feature, I'd call myself its architect.
options.line: Hmm, I'm not sure that follows.

followup.explain: 介绍项目时，先交代目标，再讲自己做的事和量出来的结果，比丢出一串工具更能让对方顺着往下问。团队定了整体方案时，要把“团队的决定”和“自己落地的部分”分开说：参与上线不等于主导架构，只讲团队成绩、等被问到再补职责，则让开场少了最关键的信息。

options.text: I'd list the tools I used first and let you choose what to ask.
options.line: Let's go back to your own part.

options.text: I'd tie the project goal to what I did and what I measured.
options.line: Okay, that's a clear way in.

node.explain: 介绍项目时，先交代目标，再讲自己做的事和量出来的结果，比丢出一串工具更能让对方顺着往下问。团队定了整体方案时，要把“团队的决定”和“自己落地的部分”分开说：参与上线不等于主导架构，只讲团队成绩、等被问到再补职责，则让开场少了最关键的信息。

node.text: What would you like us to remember about your frontend experience?

options.text: I'd focus on the biggest percentage in the project report.
options.line: Hmm, one number doesn't tell me much.

options.text: One real problem I solved and what I learned from it.
options.line: Okay, a concrete case works for me.

options.text: I'd give one result, then say what we measured and what we didn't.
options.line: Interesting. Let me dig into that.

followup.text: A project improved after several changes. Which change caused it?

options.text: I'd say what we measured, without crediting any one change.
options.line: Right, that's an honest way to put it.

options.text: I'd list all the changes and credit the overall improvement.
options.line: That's a start. Which change mattered, though?

options.text: I'd credit my change, since it was the last one we released.
options.line: Hmm, does last mean it caused it?

followup.explain: 被问到“希望我们记住什么”，一个有具体问题、有行动、有收获的例子，比报告里最大的百分比更站得住。多项改动叠加又没有对照时，不能把整体改善归到某一项上；把“最后上线的”当成“起作用的”，是拿时间先后代替了因果。

node.explain: 被问到“希望我们记住什么”，一个有具体问题、有行动、有收获的例子，比报告里最大的百分比更站得住。多项改动叠加又没有对照时，不能把整体改善归到某一项上；把“最后上线的”当成“起作用的”，是拿时间先后代替了因果。

node.text: A search response for an old query replaces the latest result. What would you change?

options.text: Check the response still matches the current query first.
options.line: Okay, that's the right place to look.

options.text: Cancel stale requests, and validate each result when it arrives.
options.line: Cancelling helps. Let me test its limit.

followup.text: The old response has already arrived, so cancelling is too late. What now?

options.text: Ignore any result whose request ID isn't the latest one.
options.line: Yes, a request ID check would do it.

options.text: Block new input until the current response has arrived.
options.line: That works, but it's heavy-handed.

options.text: Show whichever response arrives last, since it's the newest.
options.line: Hmm, is the last response always the newest?

followup.explain: 旧请求的结果盖掉新结果，是请求乱序：先发的请求不一定先返回。直接核对“这个响应是否属于当前查询”，比调长防抖更对症，因为防抖只减少请求数量。取消请求只能省下无用的工作，响应一旦到达，还得在写入界面前比对请求编号；禁用输入能避开乱序，却牺牲了连续输入的体验。

options.text: Add a longer debounce so the responses come back in order.
options.line: Hmm, would that guarantee the order?

node.explain: 旧请求的结果盖掉新结果，是请求乱序：先发的请求不一定先返回。直接核对“这个响应是否属于当前查询”，比调长防抖更对症，因为防抖只减少请求数量。取消请求只能省下无用的工作，响应一旦到达，还得在写入界面前比对请求编号；禁用输入能避开乱序，却牺牲了连续输入的体验。

node.text: A long calculation is split into many Promise callbacks, but input still feels blocked. Why?

options.text: Put every chunk in Promise.then and input will stay smooth.
options.line: Hmm, would that really help?

options.text: Microtasks run to completion before the browser handles input.
options.line: Okay, that's the key point.

options.text: I'd check the timeline, then schedule the work in bounded chunks.
options.line: Sounds reasonable. Let me test it.

followup.text: Each chunk queues another microtask. Does that guarantee a paint between chunks?

options.text: No. A microtask chain can delay rendering for a long time.
options.line: Right, microtasks can starve rendering.

options.text: Not guaranteed. I'd measure whether a paint actually happens.
options.line: Fair to measure. What would you look for?

options.text: Yes. Each Promise callback lets the browser start a new frame.
options.line: Are you sure each callback gets its own frame?

followup.explain: 把长计算拆成很多 Promise 回调，并没有把主线程让出来：微任务队列清空之前，浏览器不会处理输入，也不会绘制，不断追加微任务的链条可能长时间挡住渲染。要让输入顺畅，需要把工作拆成有边界的块并真正让出执行权，再用时间线验证。

node.explain: 把长计算拆成很多 Promise 回调，并没有把主线程让出来：微任务队列清空之前，浏览器不会处理输入，也不会绘制，不断追加微任务的链条可能长时间挡住渲染。要让输入顺畅，需要把工作拆成有边界的块并真正让出执行权，再用时间线验证。

node.text: A page feels faster after your change. How would you check the improvement?

options.text: I'd pair controlled measurements with what real users experience.
options.line: Real users, good. Here's a wrinkle.

followup.text: Lab results improve, but low-end devices still struggle. What next?

options.text: Segment the results by device group and check that interaction.
options.line: Good. Low-end devices are where it shows.

options.text: Gather more overall samples, then revisit the low-end group.
options.line: Would that show the low-end problem, though?

options.text: The lab score went up, so users on every device are better off.
options.line: Hmm, does one lab score cover every device?

followup.explain: “感觉变快了”要变成可以比较的数字：先定义目标指标，再在相近条件下比较前后两个版本，凭感觉投票既没有指标，也无法复现。实验室测量和真实用户观察可以互补，整体变好可能掩盖某类设备的退化，不能把一个实验室分数推广成“所有用户都受益”。

options.text: Ask the team to compare the two builds by feel and vote.
options.line: Hmm, a vote isn't a measurement.

options.text: Define the target metric, then compare under the same conditions.
options.line: Okay, that's a fair comparison.

node.explain: “感觉变快了”要变成可以比较的数字：先定义目标指标，再在相近条件下比较前后两个版本，凭感觉投票既没有指标，也无法复现。实验室测量和真实用户观察可以互补，整体变好可能掩盖某类设备的退化，不能把一个实验室分数推广成“所有用户都受益”。

node.text: A list update repeatedly reads element sizes after changing styles. How would you investigate?

options.text: Look for repeated layout work in the browser's performance timeline.
options.line: Okay, that's where I'd start too.

options.text: I'd group reads and writes, then compare the real interaction.
options.line: Okay, grouping makes sense. One more thing.

followup.text: A size read needs the new layout. Can caching every old size solve it?

options.text: No. A cached size is wrong as soon as the layout changes.
options.line: Right, stale sizes cause their own bugs.

options.text: Cache sizes briefly and fix any glitches as they show up.
options.line: Hmm, glitches in production cost more.

options.text: Yes. Cached sizes stay valid until the page reloads.
options.line: Hmm, is that still true once the layout changes?

followup.explain: 反复读取尺寸往往会触发强制布局，先在性能时间线里确认有没有重复布局，再决定怎么改；没测量就先换框架，是凭猜测定原因。读写分批能减少重复布局，但缓存的尺寸必须有失效条件，布局一变，旧值就不再是当前事实。

options.text: Replace the list framework before looking at any measurements.
options.line: Hmm, shouldn't we look at the data first?

node.explain: 反复读取尺寸往往会触发强制布局，先在性能时间线里确认有没有重复布局，再决定怎么改；没测量就先换框架，是凭猜测定原因。读写分批能减少重复布局，但缓存的尺寸必须有失效条件，布局一变，旧值就不再是当前事实。

node.text: A feature works with mock data, but the real API isn't ready. Is it ready to release?

options.text: Release it now and finish the real integration afterward.
options.line: Hmm, then users would be the ones testing it.

options.text: State the unverified paths and check them against release criteria.
options.line: Okay, that's a fair way to frame it.

options.text: Map the API gap to user impact, then propose a verified scope.
options.line: A verified scope. Let me check that.

followup.text: The deadline is fixed. What would you recommend to the owner?

options.text: A smaller verified scope, or a delay with the user risks stated.
options.line: That's a reasonable recommendation.

options.text: Release the UI and flag the API as another team's dependency.
options.line: That moves the risk to the other team.

options.text: Ship it all; the mock tests passed, so the risk is small.
options.line: Hmm, is a passing mock test enough?

followup.explain: mock 数据跑通，只能说明界面这一段的逻辑，真实接口、鉴权、错误处理还没验证。回答前先说清哪些没验证、发布标准是什么。截止日期固定时，可以建议缩小到已验证的范围，或写明风险后顺延；只发界面、把接口丢给别的团队，等于让用户承担联调。

node.explain: mock 数据跑通，只能说明界面这一段的逻辑，真实接口、鉴权、错误处理还没验证。回答前先说清哪些没验证、发布标准是什么。截止日期固定时，可以建议缩小到已验证的范围，或写明风险后顺延；只发界面、把接口丢给别的团队，等于让用户承担联调。

node.text: The new version reports fewer errors than the old one. Would you expand the rollout?

options.text: I'd check key-task completion, not just the error counter.
options.line: Good instinct. Let me add a wrinkle.

followup.text: Errors and success events both vanish while entry traffic stays normal. What then?

options.text: Pause the rollout and verify the telemetry and the user journey.
options.line: Yes, check the telemetry before anything else.

options.text: Wait for more events before deciding whether the build is healthy.
options.line: How long would you wait?

options.text: Fewer errors on the dashboard, so the fix seems to be working.
options.line: Hmm, could the errors just not be reported?

followup.explain: 报错比旧版少，不一定是新版更好：可能是流量少了，也可能是上报坏了。先看关键任务的完成情况和采集覆盖，再比较同一路径上的失败率。成功事件和错误事件同时消失、入口流量却正常，更像监控链路出了问题，应先暂停放量、核对埋点，而不是把“没有报错”当成修复成功。

options.text: Expand if the new version's error count stays lower.
options.line: Hmm, is the error count enough to decide?

options.text: I'd verify coverage and compare failure rates per journey.
options.line: Okay, same journey is a fair comparison.

node.explain: 报错比旧版少，不一定是新版更好：可能是流量少了，也可能是上报坏了。先看关键任务的完成情况和采集覆盖，再比较同一路径上的失败率。成功事件和错误事件同时消失、入口流量却正常，更像监控链路出了问题，应先暂停放量、核对埋点，而不是把“没有报错”当成修复成功。

node.text: Tell me about a mistake you made. Walk me through what happened.

options.text: I'd explain my decision, its impact, and how I corrected it.
options.line: Okay, that's a clear shape.

options.text: I could use the incident from {cite.short} and own my part.
options.line: Okay, let's hear it.

followup.text: Once the change was live and something broke, what did you do?

options.text: I rolled back first, then added regression tests for that case.
options.line: Good. Rolling back first was the right call.

options.text: I fixed the immediate problem and left prevention for later.
options.line: And when does the prevention happen?

options.text: I'd call it an API issue outside my part.
options.line: Hmm, I'm not sure that follows.

followup.explain: 讲失败案例时，要交代发生了什么、你负责哪一块、做了什么、结果如何，重点是自己的决定和修正；把优点包装成缺点（比如“要求太高”），就回避了问题本身。止损之后还要说明怎样减少同类问题：回滚让用户恢复使用，补测试才是防止再发生；把责任推给别的环节，这个故事就站不住了。

fallback.text: I'd explain a decision I got wrong and what I changed.

followup.text: If you face a similar incident, what would you do first?

options.text: Restore the critical path, then verify and write down the cause.
options.line: Okay, that order makes sense.

options.text: Apply a quick fix, then ask users whether the problem is gone.
options.line: Is the users' problem actually solved, though?

options.text: Keep the release running while I finish tracing the exact cause.
options.line: Hmm, that keeps users affected for longer.

followup.explain: 没有对应经历时，可以讲假设的处理方式，不必为了回答而编一次事故。先恢复关键路径，再验证和记录，比用户还在受影响时先去追根因更合理。

options.text: I'd describe a time my high standards slowed the team down.
options.line: Hmm, I asked about a real mistake.

node.explain: 讲失败案例时，要交代发生了什么、你负责哪一块、做了什么、结果如何，重点是自己的决定和修正；把优点包装成缺点（比如“要求太高”），就回避了问题本身。止损之后还要说明怎样减少同类问题：回滚让用户恢复使用，补测试才是防止再发生；把责任推给别的环节，这个故事就站不住了。

node.text: Tell me about learning an unfamiliar tool under a deadline. How did you know you could use it?

options.text: I'd separate reading docs from shipping a real task.
options.line: A real task, okay. Let me push on that.

followup.text: A demo works, but your real feature has edge cases. How do you proceed?

options.text: Test the relevant failure cases before widening the scope.
options.line: Good, edge cases are where it breaks.

options.text: Follow the demo pattern and collect edge cases after handoff.
options.line: Okay, but who finds the edge cases?

options.text: The demo works, so I'd treat it as ready for production.
options.line: Hmm, does a demo cover real usage?

followup.explain: “怎么知道自己能用”需要证据：一个具体任务、一个能跑通的小例子、踩过哪些坑。跑通教程或演示不等于能处理真实需求，要说明具体约束、用什么样例验证、哪些边界还没覆盖；学习时长只能说明投入，不能单独证明会用。

options.text: I'd list the tutorials I finished and the hours I put in.
options.line: Hmm, hours tell me about effort, not ability.

options.text: I'd describe the task and a small working example.
options.line: Okay, a working example helps.

node.explain: “怎么知道自己能用”需要证据：一个具体任务、一个能跑通的小例子、踩过哪些坑。跑通教程或演示不等于能处理真实需求，要说明具体约束、用什么样例验证、哪些边界还没覆盖；学习时长只能说明投入，不能单独证明会用。

node.text: A partner team is offline in another time zone, and an API decision blocks you. What would you send?

options.text: Schedule a meeting in the middle of their night so we decide today.
options.line: Hmm, that's a lot to ask of them.

options.text: The decision needed, the options, and a reply deadline.
options.line: Okay, that's easy to act on.

options.text: A small example of the user impact, plus my recommendation.
options.line: Concrete, I like that. What happens next?

followup.text: There's no reply before your planned handoff. What do you do?

options.text: Escalate as agreed, and keep going on what doesn't depend on them.
options.line: Yes, that's how I'd handle it too.

options.text: Pick a temporary format and ask them to adjust it later.
options.line: That could mean rework for them.

options.text: I'd treat their silence as approval and publish the contract.
options.line: Hmm, is silence really a yes?

followup.explain: 对方不在线时，发出去的消息应该自带决策所需的信息和回复时限，而不是约一个对方半夜的会。没回复不等于同意：超过约定时间就按升级机制处理，同时推进不依赖这项决定的工作，避免单方面改动公共接口。

node.explain: 对方不在线时，发出去的消息应该自带决策所需的信息和回复时限，而不是约一个对方半夜的会。没回复不等于同意：超过约定时间就按升级机制处理，同时推进不依赖这项决定的工作，避免单方面改动公共接口。

node.text: Describe a disagreement where your initial idea wasn't chosen. How did you handle it?

options.text: I'd explain each side's constraints, the decision, and what I did.
options.line: Okay, that's a clear outline.

options.text: I'd show the evidence that changed what I recommended.
options.line: Evidence, okay. And the other side?

followup.text: What if the accepted option is less convenient for frontend work?

options.text: Weigh the whole task's cost and honor the agreed contract.
options.line: Fair. That's a mature way to look at it.

options.text: Accept the decision, but ask to revisit it after launch.
options.line: Okay, and how would you work in the meantime?

options.text: Use my preferred interface and adapt the backend response later.
options.line: Hmm, who maintains that adapter later?

followup.explain: 分歧题要讲清双方各自的约束、最后是怎么定的、你之后做了什么；把重点放在“为什么我的方案更好”，就成了为自己辩护。自己的方案没被采纳不等于失败，要看整个任务的总成本，并执行已经确认的约定。接受决定的同时提出上线后复盘是可以的，但还要说明眼下怎样配合；用自己偏好的接口、让后端以后再适配，是把成本推给了别人。

options.text: Focus on why my approach was better.
options.line: Hmm, I wanted to hear how you handled it.

node.explain: 分歧题要讲清双方各自的约束、最后是怎么定的、你之后做了什么；把重点放在“为什么我的方案更好”，就成了为自己辩护。自己的方案没被采纳不等于失败，要看整个任务的总成本，并执行已经确认的约定。接受决定的同时提出上线后复盘是可以的，但还要说明眼下怎样配合；用自己偏好的接口、让后端以后再适配，是把成本推给了别人。

node.text: Two teams both call their request urgent. How would you decide what to work on first?

options.text: I'd lay out impact and trade-offs for the owner who sets priority.
options.line: Okay, and if they still disagree?

followup.text: Both owners still disagree. What would you do while they decide?

options.text: Flag the blocker and keep working on the part everyone agrees on.
options.line: Good, that keeps things moving.

options.text: Split my time equally so both teams see visible progress.
options.line: Is equal time really the best split?

options.text: Promise both teams their deadlines and sort it out privately.
options.line: Hmm, what happens when both deadlines slip?

followup.explain: 排优先级要看任务的影响和依赖，冲突交给有决定权的人去解。两位负责人仍没有结论时，自己不替他们裁决，也不藏起风险：把阻塞点明确提出来，同时推进有共识的独立部分。均分时间未必保护关键路径，同时答应两边的原定期限，只是把冲突往后推。

options.text: Start with the team whose lead contacted me most recently.
options.line: Hmm, is that how you'd decide?

options.text: Compare user impact, dependencies, and deadlines for both teams.
options.line: Okay, that's a sensible start.

node.explain: 排优先级要看任务的影响和依赖，冲突交给有决定权的人去解。两位负责人仍没有结论时，自己不替他们裁决，也不藏起风险：把阻塞点明确提出来，同时推进有共识的独立部分。均分时间未必保护关键路径，同时答应两边的原定期限，只是把冲突往后推。

node.text: A teammate must maintain your feature while you are away. What makes the handoff useful?

options.text: Send the entire chat history so no discussion gets lost.
options.line: Hmm, they'd have to read all of it.

options.text: I'd document current behavior, known gaps, and the next owner.
options.line: Okay, that's what they'll need.

options.text: I'd have them run one real task from my handoff notes.
options.line: A dry run. Let me follow up on that.

followup.text: The feature still uses a mock API. What should the notes make clear?

options.text: What's still untested, who owns it, and when to escalate.
options.line: Right, that's what the next owner needs.

options.text: Link the backend contact and ask the new owner to chase it.
options.line: That hands them a chase, not a status.

options.text: Mark the API as done, since the mock response matches the spec.
options.line: Hmm, is the mock the same as production?

followup.explain: 交接的目的，是让接手的人能直接继续做下去：现在是什么行为、还有什么缺口、下一步归谁；聊天记录只能当参考。功能还在用 mock 接口时，要区分“模拟通过”和“真实验证”，写明未完成的部分、负责人和跟进时点；把接口标成已完成，会让后面的人以为不用再验证。

pitch.text: I'd walk through the loading work I did on {hl.subject}.
pitch.line: Okay, let's dig into that one.

followup.text: What exactly does that improvement tell us?

options.text: Lighthouse timings under test conditions, not what every user sees.
options.line: Right. Lab numbers are a fair start.

options.text: Lighthouse showed about four seconds down to two.
options.line: Okay, can you say more?

options.text: It loads twice as fast now, so conversion should roughly double.
options.line: Hmm, I'm not sure that follows.

followup.explain: 首屏耗时是用 Lighthouse 在固定条件下测得的实验室数据，能说明页面加载变快了多少，但不等于真实用户的体验，更不能直接换算成转化率。只报一个数字、不说测量条件，数字就失去了参考价值。

pitch.text: I'd explain the timer issue in {hl.subject}.
pitch.line: Okay, tell me how it recovers.

followup.text: A background tab delays callbacks. How should a countdown recover?

options.text: Compute from the end time when it resumes, not from counting ticks.
options.line: Yes, that's how it should recover.

options.text: Fetch the current time from the server when the page wakes up.
options.line: That works, but it adds a server call.

options.text: Subtract one per tick; the browser fires timers on schedule.
options.line: Are you sure timers fire on schedule?

followup.explain: 倒计时不能靠回调的次数来代表经过的时间。后台标签页里的定时器会被延迟，所以要围绕目标时刻计算剩余时间，页面恢复时重新核对；提高回调频率弥补不了浏览器的限流。向服务器取时间也能校准，但多了一次请求，仍然需要以目标时刻为基准。

timer_drift.explain: 倒计时不能靠回调的次数来代表经过的时间。后台标签页里的定时器会被延迟，所以要围绕目标时刻计算剩余时间，页面恢复时重新核对；提高回调频率弥补不了浏览器的限流。向服务器取时间也能校准，但多了一次请求，仍然需要以目标时刻为基准。

followup.text: What happened, and what did you change afterward?

options.text: The order button broke; I rolled back and added tests.
options.line: Good, that's the right sequence.

options.text: I fixed the immediate problem and left the tests for later.
options.line: And when did the tests get added?

options.text: It was a deployment issue, so there was nothing for me to change.
options.line: Hmm, so whose change was it?

followup.explain: 事故复盘要讲清具体影响、当时的止损动作和之后补上的防护。把问题推给部署之类的其他环节，等于放弃了自己负责的改动；只修眼前的问题、不补测试，同类错误还会再出现。

pitch.text: I'd explain how I split up the loading in the marketplace app.
pitch.line: Okay, the loading split. Go on.

followup.text: Did splitting the bundle make every later page load faster?

options.text: No. It lightened the first load, but later pages fetch their own code.
options.line: Fair, that's an honest trade-off.

options.text: It cut the first-load time to under a second.
options.line: Okay, but what about the other pages?

options.text: Yes. The main package is small now, so every page opens fast.
options.line: Are you sure every page gets faster?

followup.explain: 分包减轻的是首次加载的负担，后面的页面可能还要另外加载自己的代码，所以不能说“所有页面都变快了”。如实的说法是：首次打开压到了 1 秒内，后续页面要看各自的加载情况。

followup.explain: 单元测试的价值在于抓住边界行为：跨月选日期时，结束日期可能早于开始日期。回答要落到具体的失败用例和修正上，而不是只说“代码更整洁了”，或把原因笼统地归给浏览器。

unit_test_bug.explain: 单元测试的价值在于抓住边界行为：跨月选日期时，结束日期可能早于开始日期。回答要落到具体的失败用例和修正上，而不是只说“代码更整洁了”，或把原因笼统地归给浏览器。

probe_js_proto_en.text: You've listed expert JavaScript. When you call a regular function with new, what happens?

options.text: It creates an object, links its prototype, and runs the function.
options.line: Okay, that's the basic sequence.

options.text: I'd walk through creation, this binding, and the return value.
options.line: Okay, go ahead.

followup.text: The constructor explicitly returns an object. What does new give back?

options.text: The returned object replaces the newly created instance.
options.line: Correct. Plenty of people miss that rule.

options.text: Either the returned object or the new instance; I'd test which.
options.line: Testing is fine, but what's the rule?

options.text: It always returns the new instance and ignores an explicit return.
options.line: Hmm, are you sure about that?

followup.explain: 普通函数作为构造函数调用时，如果显式返回的是对象，new 的结果就是这个对象；只有返回原始值（或没有 return）时，才得到新创建的实例。这里只讨论普通函数，不涉及 class 派生构造器的额外规则。

options.text: It calls the function and copies its methods onto a new object.
options.line: Hmm, is that all it does?

probe_js_proto_en.explain: 用 new 调用普通函数时，会创建一个新对象，把它的原型指向构造函数的 prototype，再以这个对象为 this 执行函数，最后还要看返回值：显式返回对象时，结果就是那个对象。它不是把方法逐个复制到新对象上。

probe_vue_source_en.text: You've listed Vue as a strength. If you destructure a primitive field out of reactive(), what gets lost?

options.text: The local value no longer reads through the original proxy.
options.line: Okay, that's the core of it.

options.text: I'd separate the local binding from a nested object's value.
options.line: Okay, local binding. Let me probe that.

followup.text: What if the destructured value is itself a reactive object?

options.text: Changes inside it are still tracked; the binding is what differs.
options.line: Yes, that's the distinction that matters.

options.text: I'd keep reading through the proxy instead of destructuring.
options.line: That avoids it, but why does it happen?

options.text: After destructuring, no nested change is reactive any more.
options.line: Hmm, even for nested objects?

followup.explain: 解构出来的值本身是对象时，它仍然是响应式代理，修改内部的属性依然可以被追踪；变化的只是那个局部变量的绑定。要把“局部绑定”和“代理对象内部的变化”分开看。

options.text: Destructuring keeps the reactive link for every kind of value.
options.line: Hmm, is that true for every value?

probe_vue_source_en.explain: 从 reactive 对象里解构出原始值字段后，得到的只是普通的局部变量，读写不再经过原来的代理，也就不会被追踪。字段本身是对象时则不同：拿到的仍是响应式代理，修改它内部的属性依然可以触发更新，所以不能概括成“解构之后一切都失去响应”。

probe_react_master_en.text: You've listed expert React. How do you deal with stale values inside an effect?

options.text: Expert overstates it. I only built a small demo from a tutorial.
options.line: Thanks for being upfront about that.

options.text: I'd adjust the dependencies, then re-check all the captured values.
options.line: Okay. Do you know why they go stale?

options.text: React infers missing dependencies, so no code change is needed.
options.line: Hmm, are you sure React does that?

probe_react_master_en.explain: 依赖没写全时，effect 会读到旧的值；React 不会替你补依赖，这是闭包里最常见的坑。被追问到“精通”时，如实说明实际水平，比含糊地讲思路、或自信地讲错损失更小；最好一开始就按真实水平来写。
